coordinate_qualification.rule: Apply the same exact-identity C3 harmonization as microglia: UCSC liftOver v479, minMatch=0.95, single mapping, same chromosome, zero interval-length change, exact hg38->hg19 round trip for both anchors.

orientation_and_gene_identity.neuron: Exactly one anchor overlaps >=1 bp of a Nott promoter row with NeuN_active_promoter==True.
orientation_and_gene_identity.oligodendrocyte: Exactly one anchor overlaps >=1 bp of a Nott promoter row with Olig2_active_promoter==True.
orientation_and_gene_identity.unique_gene_rule: Overlapping promoter annotations must resolve to exactly one non-empty Nearest Ensembl and exactly one non-empty Gene Name.

microglial_expression_condition.rule: Exact case-insensitive Gene Name match to GSE73721 Gene and mean FPKM across the three human myeloid samples > 0.5.

microglial_distal_accessibility_conditio.rule: Candidate distal hg38 interval overlaps >=1 bp of >=1 PU1/microglia ATAC peak.

relationship_absence_from_microglia.microglia_reference_population: C3-qualified, source-oriented, unique-Ensembl-resolved microglia promoter-distal contacts.
relationship_absence_from_microglia.supported_in_microglia: Same Nearest Ensembl gene AND >=1 bp overlap between candidate and any microglia distal hg38 interval.

valid_P3_negative.rule: Coordinate-qualified, uniquely oriented/gene-resolved neuron or oligo edge; gene expressed in microglia; distal accessible in microglia; same gene-distal relationship absent from microglia contact map.
valid_P3_negative.trivial_negative_definition: Expression-fail or microglial-accessibility-fail edges are trivial negatives and excluded.
